stories.hook: Translating scattered trial data into a public Bayesian atlas that models upper-bound life-year gains from overlapping interventions while exposing every assumption for inspection.
stories.deck: Stuart Berkowitz says his public Bayesian models deliver an extra life year for 3.5 cents—far below any charity he has examined—by combining scattered trial data into joint probabilities that remove overlapping effects across interventions.
